card.name: Past-tense verb after a subject noun
card.fires_on: Past-tense helpers like "was" or "had" right after a subject in news or science prose describing a past event. Also the "0" inside a year such as 2004, 2005 or 2012.

modes.label: Past-tense "was/had"
modes.description: "was" or "had" right after a subject noun, stating something that happened or held in the past.
modes.example: “The National Park of Cabrera<< was>> created to protect one of the most diverse

modes.label: Inside a year
modes.description: The "0" digit in a 2000s year after "in" or "from".
modes.example: Coal is expected to supply about 29% of energy demand in 2030, up from 26% in 2<<0>>05.

card.writes: It favors words about what usually follows or lasts after an event, and disfavors "currently" or "up to now" words.
card.plain: It fires on words that put a statement in the past, like "was" after a subject or the middle of a year like 2005.
